Synopsis:
    The Georgian government is demolishing the Rike Park Music Theatre and Exhibition Hall ("Rike Tubes") in Tbilisi, a modernist complex built under the previous pro-Western Saakashvili government. The ruling Georgian Dream party approved the demolition, scheduled for completion by December 25. The move has drawn local and international criticism, including from the Italian architects (Fuksas Studio) who designed it, but carries no significant geopolitical or economic dimensions beyond a domestic cultural/political dispute.
